manifest.name: 下载
manifest.summary: 通用下载器：任意链接、队列、断点续传

actions.name: add
actions.summary: Downloads one or more files from http(s) URLs using the host download engine. Transfers keep running when the app is backgrounded or killed, and resume after interruptions. Choose where the file lands with "destination": "sandbox" (default, always works), "iCloud", "externalFiles" (a folder the user authorized in Settings), or "vault" (the notes vault). Returns task ids — poll with the list action for progress. Large files are fine; there is no size cap.
actions.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","required":["urls"],"properties":{"urls":{"type":"array","maxItems":30,"items":{"type":"string"},"description":"One or more absolute http(s) URLs."},"filename":{"type":"string","description":"Saved name for a single URL. Ignored when several urls are given."},"destination":{"type":"string","enum":["sandbox","iCloud","externalFiles","vault"],"description":"Where files land. Default sandbox."},"folder":{"type":"string","description":"Relative subfolder inside the destination root."},"priority":{"type":"string","enum":["low","normal","high"]}},"additionalProperties":false}

actions.name: list
actions.summary: Lists this app's downloads with live progress: state, bytes received, percentage, speed, and the saved path once finished. Filter with "state" (active / finished / running / queued / paused / completed / failed / cancelled). Only shows downloads started from this app — the host's own downloads and other apps' downloads are never included.

actions.name: control
actions.summary: Pauses, resumes, cancels or removes downloads. Give "taskId" for one task, or omit it to act on all of this app's downloads. "clearFinished" drops finished records from the list without deleting any downloaded file. Paused downloads keep their resume data, so resuming continues instead of restarting.
actions.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","required":["action"],"properties":{"action":{"type":"string","enum":["pause","resume","cancel","remove","clearFinished"]},"taskId":{"type":"string","description":"Omit to act on every download of this app."}},"additionalProperties":false}

actions.name: pauseAll
actions.summary: Pause every download of this app from the ⋯ menu. Drives the visible queue, so it is a UI action rather than an agent tool — the agent uses the control action instead.

actions.name: resumeAll
actions.summary: Resume every paused download of this app from the ⋯ menu.

actions.name: clearFinished
actions.summary: Remove finished records from the visible list. Downloaded files are not deleted.
